A '''Trade''' was an event when two [[Abyssin/Legends|Abyssin]] tribes met in the deserts of [[Byss (Abyssin)/Legends|Byss]]. When two tribes met, usually at an artesian spring, either a Trade or a [[Blooding]] ensued depending on the amount of [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] or [[Water/Legends|water]] present. If food and water was abundant, a Trade was called where the two tribes swapped everything from [[gaunt]]s, weapons,<ref name="GG4">''[[Galaxy Guide 4: Alien Races]]''</ref> and young males and females.<ref name="GG4-2">[[Galaxy Guide 4: Alien Races (Second Edition)|''Galaxy Guide 4: Alien Races'', Second Edition]]</ref>
